article.title: Right to education
article.content:
21ARight to education

Article 21A · Part III · Right to Freedom
1[The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.]

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002, s. 2 (w.e.f. 1-4-2010).
